Made for the way the drink is served.

Barrier coating technology

Choose for the market and disposal system.

Coating requirements vary by region. Soilable can advise which series fits the intended market and waste stream.

Series

zero

Water-based barrier coating. Designed to recycle with normal paper waste and degrade on land and in the ocean in months.

Upon request

bio

Bio-polymer coating using BioPBS. Recyclable with paper cups and suited to markets with composting facilities.

Upon request

oxo

Fossil-polymer coating using oxo-PE. Recyclable with paper cups for markets where this coating is accepted.
